pull.title: fix: quarantine anomalous Stripe refund responses
pull.body:
## Summary
- distinguish a Stripe transport/ambiguous failure from a successful provider call whose returned Refund violates doFast's expected business contract
- stop automatic refund retries immediately when a stable provider response is known but anomalous
- preserve a verified provider refund id/status only when the returned refund still belongs to the requested PaymentIntent
- do not persist an untrusted refund id or provider status when Stripe's response points at a different PaymentIntent
- keep reserved wallet funds untouched while the request is quarantined in REVIEW_REQUIRED
- preserve webhook-wins races: a signed webhook that settles the request before the synchronous response is recorded is never regressed back to review
- add gateway, dispatcher, entity and request-service regression coverage

## Financial invariant
A known provider-side refund response must never be reclassified as a replayable transport failure. Conversely, provider identity from a response that references another PaymentIntent must not be attached to the local refund request. In both cases automatic provider replay is stopped and wallet reserve remains held until a verified webhook or manual review resolves the state.

## Schema
No Flyway migration. No wallet/ledger schema changes.

## Merge gate
Merge only after exact-head Maven/API, frontend test/audit/lint/build, Production Compose, full runtime, payment/refund financial smokes, CodeQL and container security are green; verify master is unchanged and the branch is 0 commits behind.
